_comment: ENG-1603 — no plaintext employer names or literal RED-ALERT copy live in this file by design. Employer names are SHA-256 hashes of the lowercased name; the golden regression set is SHA-256 hashes of the exact removed PR#215 sentences (normalize: trim, lowercase, collapse whitespace). Both are one-way — grepping this file for any of the PR#215 strings or company names returns zero hits.

goldenRegression.normalize: trim, lowercase, collapse internal whitespace to single space
goldenRegression.description: Hashes of the exact sentences removed by PR#215 (the RED-ALERT copy). A public source file whose normalized text hashes to one of these is a verbatim regression of the removed exposure, independent of the pattern/token rules above.

_allowlistFormat: Each entry: { "pattern": "<literal substring or /regex/>", "justification": "<why this is legitimate, not circumvention>" }. A source line matched by a denylist rule is skipped if it also matches an allowlist pattern.
